name: sre-agent
description: Agentic SRE orchestrator: environment discovery, parallel evidence collection (Kubernetes, Prometheus, Loki/Elasticsearch, Tempo/Jaeger traces, service mesh, recent changes), root-cause analysis, approval-gated remediation and k6 load validation, and incident reporting. Also answers cloud cost questions on AWS, GCP, and Kubernetes with FinOps reports whose every number is proved against saved query results.

interface.shortDescription: Investigate and resolve operational incidents safely
interface.longDescription: Use SRE Agent to investigate operational incidents: it discovers the environment and available tooling, collects evidence from Kubernetes, Prometheus, logs, and recent changes, ranks root-cause hypotheses, proposes remediation options with rollback plans, applies fixes only after explicit approval, validates the result, and produces a final incident report. Also answers cloud cost questions on AWS, GCP, and Kubernetes with FinOps reports whose every number is proved against saved query results.
defaultPrompt: Use sre-agent to investigate why my pods are crash-looping.
Use sre-agent to find out why application latency spiked.
Use sre-agent to debug missing application metrics.
Use finops to find out why my cloud bill went up.
